summary_1line: Ravana and his siblings perform severe austerities, receive boons from Brahma, Ravana rises to power and oppresses the worlds, prompting the gods to plan Vishnu’s incarnation.

image_candidates.scene_text: Ravana stands on one leg amid five blazing fires, offering his severed heads into the sacred flame after a thousand years of penance.
Brahma appears before the emaciated ascetics in a radiant glow, granting boons to Ravana, Kumbhakarna, and the righteous Vibhishana.
Ravana seizes the celestial chariot Pushpaka from Kuvera as the defeated lord of wealth pronounces a curse upon him.
